title: eugenia alagoensis
intro: Eugenia alagoensis, commonly known as the Alagoas Eugenia or Eugenia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia alagoensis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
